basis: Grass SPEECHLESS paralog that drives stomatal file establishment (Raissig et al. 2016 PNAS)
validation: translational fusion: BdSPCH2-YFP marks stomatal cell files from the earliest stage through GMCs (Fig. 3B); bdspch2 mutants have far fewer stomata

basis: Grass SPEECHLESS paralog, partly redundant with BdSPCH2 (Raissig et al. 2016 PNAS)
validation: translational fusion: BdSPCH1-YFP weak early, peaks in mature GMCs (Fig. 3A); mild mutant phenotype on its own

basis: bHLH partner of SPCH/MUTE/FAMA that is essential for stomatal initiation in Brachypodium (Raissig et al. 2016 PNAS)
validation: translational fusion: BdSCRM2-YFP specifically in the stomatal lineage at all stages (Fig. 2, S1); bdscrm2 mutants lack stomata

basis: ICE1/SCRM-type bHLH partner expressed throughout the stomatal lineage; redundant with BdSCRM2 (Raissig et al. 2016 PNAS)
validation: translational fusion: BdICE1-YFP across stomatal lineage stages (Fig. S1B-F)

basis: MUTE ortholog expressed in GMCs whose mobile protein specifies subsidiary cells (Raissig et al. 2017 Science; Spiegelhalder et al. 2024 Development)
validation: RNA-FISH and 3xGFP-BdMUTE in GMCs, with the protein moving into subsidiary mother cells; bdmute (sid) lacks subsidiary cells

basis: FAMA ortholog necessary and sufficient for grass guard cell fate (McKown et al. 2023 Plant Cell)
validation: translational fusion: BdFAMApro:YFP-BdFAMA low in GMCs, peaks in young GCs, persists in mature complexes; bdfama lacks functional GCs
